description: Wall-clock seconds (best of 3, process start included) to build an array of n integers on Tomato, release/0.4.3, Apple M2 Max, 2026-11-10. 'map': one (0..n).map(); 'idiom': one element at a time with the (0..a.size() + 1).map() idiom (issue #145); 'append_copy': one element at a time with items + [x] through a successor call, every step a copy (OKKAMA_ARRAYS=flat, arrays as in 0.4.2); 'append': the same with the shared buffers of 0.4.3 (issue #246). Points above 10 s are left out. Generator: okkama-docs/benchmarks/persistence/fig81 (fig81.ok, measure.py).
